title: Siege of Mariupol
summary: During Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine, the port city of Mariupol was besieged and bombarded. Civilians were trapped, and a drama theater sheltering them was destroyed. Ukrainian defenders held out in the Azovstal steel plant, from which a UN-Red Cross operation evacuated civilians by 1 May 2022.

importance.justification: A major, prolonged urban siege of the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine, with a large civilian toll and war-crime allegations.

audience_note: Contains references to civilian deaths, bombardment and alleged war crimes.

reviewer_note: Sources give no explicit start or end date for the siege; the Wikidata dates of 25 February to 20 May 2022 are not confirmed by them. The sources show the siege was ongoing on 19 March and 1 May 2022 only. The 20,000 civilian death figure is a mayor's report and is not in the summary.
